_about: US dollars per million tokens, at API list price. The phase report shows each ticket's cost at these rates. It is a usage gauge: a subscription plan is not billed per token. cacheWrite is the 1-hour cache rate (2x input), the TTL Claude Code uses; at the 5-minute rate (1.25x) a ticket costs a little less. Brigade updates this file when the price list changes; a model not listed is priced as `fallback`. Haiku's row is its rate for prompts up to 100K tokens (above that it costs 5x), so a long Haiku session reads low.
